answer: Locks are published in whisper, expire in ocean, and prism lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 78 aliases therefore needs 115 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2606 identities would post 2820 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
